verdict.rationale: An availability SLA is a fair question for a paid LLM inference API, so the axis applies. The pack only shows service tiers described as tunable for 'latency, throughput, and reliability' and a list of upgrade benefits (higher limits, Flex, Batch, Spend Limits). No stated uptime or availability SLA appears for any paid or enterprise tier, so this is adjacent material and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a stated availability SLA on paid or enterprise tiers
